title: 2026-11-05_Linux_P2P_Ransom_Botnet_Investigation_3b6
description: Investigate a Linux P2P Ransom botnet malware attack on a victim machine.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim machine was attacked by the Linux P2P Ransom botnet malware. The attackers encrypted some files and left a ransom note behind. Your task is to investigate the attack, identify the indicators of compromise, and take appropriate actions to mitigate the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim machine with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim machine with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation

levels.title: Identify C2 Server Port
levels.content: The attackers encrypted some files and left a ransom note behind. Read this note and identify the C2 server port number.
levels.solution:
The final flag is `4443`. 1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the home directory of the user cyrano.
3. Read the contents of the file `RANSOM_NOTE.txt`.
4. Identify the C2 server port number mentioned in the ransom note.

hints.title: Navigate to Home Directory
hints.content: Use the `cd` command to navigate to the home directory.

hints.title: Read the Ransom Note
hints.content: Use the `cat` command to read the contents of the file.

hints.title: Find the C2 Server Port
hints.content: Look for the line that mentions the C2 server port number.

levels.title: Identify Ransomware Script
levels.content: The attacker left the ransomware script describing different steps performed by the ransomware malware. Identify this script.
levels.solution:
The final flag is `/tmp/.crypt_agent`. 1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
3. Look for hidden files using the `ls -la` command.
4. Identify the ransomware script.

hints.title: Navigate to /tmp Directory
hints.content: Use the `cd /tmp/` command to navigate to the `/tmp` directory.

hints.title: List Hidden Files
hints.content: Use the `ls -la` command to list all files, including hidden ones.

hints.title: Identify the Script
hints.content: Look for a file that resembles a script.

levels.title: Identify Exfiltration Destination
levels.content: Analyze the script identified in the previous step to find the remote destination used to send files to the exfiltration server.
levels.solution:
The final flag is `exfil-server:/var/exfil/victim/`. 1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
3. Read the contents of the ransomware script identified in the previous step.
4. Identify the remote destination used for exfiltration.

hints.title: Navigate to /tmp Directory
hints.content: Use the `cd /tmp/` command to navigate to the `/tmp` directory.

hints.title: Read the Script
hints.content: Use the `cat` command to read the contents of the script.

hints.title: Find the Exfiltration Destination
hints.content: Look for the `rsync` command and its arguments in the `_exfil()` function.
